propositions: The transition library signature must unify to force: str | None matching claim's shape, removing the split force: bool + force_close + reason params and mapping legacy calls via deprecation aliases.

The transition and claim CLI must both accept --force[=<reason>] as the sole force-bypass surface, with bare --force → '(no reason given)' and empty string treated as present/audit-safe, eliminating --reason as a fallback force note.

The in-memory force-reason concept must be spelled force_reason uniformly across transition_compute, claim_compute, and internal plumbing (transition.py, txn.py), while retaining the persisted status_data['force_close_reason'] key unchanged for durability.
The force bypass must drive both start-work gate and completion-verify close gate uniformly via force is not None, removing the redundant force_close keying.
All guidance strings (gates.py override hints, txn.py override hints, transition help/usage) must show only the --force[=<reason>] pattern with no --reason-as-force-note wording.

Canonical explicit force input must win over deprecated force_close aliases even when both are supplied, and NDJSON imports must omit force to preserve completion-gate policy and per-row fail-open behavior.
